column1: # Words where «е» reads as «э» (a hard consonant in loanwords). Only the input of the acoustic model changes.
#   @NAME<TAB>endings by commas (an empty ending is the stem itself)   - a class of endings
#   stem<TAB>stem with «э»<TAB>endings and @NAME classes by commas     - the forms "stem + ending"
# Only the «е» of the stem change: the stem with «э» differs from the stem in these letters only. A form stands once.
# No form may be a Russian word too: «тест» has no forms shared with «тесто».
